interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous paved sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a safe, accessible path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Midblock Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island and a High-Intensity Activated Crosswalk (HAWK) signal to facilitate safe crossing.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to increase pedestrian comfort and safety.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks and Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Install marked crossings with pedestrian refuge islands to facilitate safer crossing of the wide thoroughfare.

interventions.title: Access Management
interventions.description: Install curbing and defined driveway aprons to limit vehicle crossing points and protect the pedestrian path.
